latest_final: The reporter's dim guesthouse room had a window directly opposite her bed. In the poor light, a real man was standing close outside the glass, staring in at her; framed by the dark window casing, his motionless head and shoulders looked exactly like a framed portrait of a man. Believing it was merely a picture, she went to sleep unalarmed and without shielding herself. In the morning, daylight revealed genuine outdoor scenery through the glass around where the figure had been—real trees and sky rather than a painted background—proving the 'frame' was a window frame and the figure had been a living man outside. She was stunned because she realized the 'portrait' was a peeping intruder who had watched her through the night while she slept and undressed, believing herself safe with only a picture before her.
